findings.issue: Feminine adjectives modify the feminine head שְׂאֵת; הַנֶּגַע is masculine. Spanish attaches white and reddish to la plaga.
צָרַעַת is a common noun left as the untranslated lemma tsaráat.
קָרַחַת is baldness of the crown/back of the head, distinct from forehead-baldness גַּבַּחַת. calvicie drops that location.

notes: Priest, object, hinneh, or, appearance, and skin-of-flesh match the tokens.
